text:
mike_support: Hey — customer acme-analytics (tenant: ten-923) seeing intermittent 503s and occasional "early EOF" on streaming responses since ~09:30 UTC. Repro steps below.
sara_support: Can you paste the curl/SDK call they used?
mike_support: They use our python SDK v0.9.4 with streaming enabled. Minimal curl reproducer they provided:
```
curl -v -N -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -d '{"model":"rwkv-13b","input":"hello"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

ethan_backend: Logs show FIN before full response, upstream returned 200 then connection reset in ~1.2s. Edge proxy (envoy) reports "early EOF" and HTTP/2 RST_STREAM 2. Suspect keepalive mismatch or chunking.

olson_infra: Any recent haproxy/envoy config changes in US-WEST? :eyes: 

ethan_backend: No config changes. We did roll a kernel tcp_tw_reuse tweak to a canary host yesterday — might be related.

mike_support: Customer noticed SDK retries 3x causing bursts and possible double billing. Is there a quick mitigation we can recommend instead of a full infra rollback?
sara_support: Temporary mitigation: set SDK max_retries=1 and streaming=False, or switch customer to our Hosted fallback model id "redwood-lite" which avoids streaming paths. Also advise increasing client-side request timeout.

ethan_backend: Can we get packet captures from the edge for tenant ten-923 for the 09:28-09:40 window? @olson_infra please.

olson_infra: Got them, uploading to S3: https://s3.company/ten-923/4950012345-pcap.pcap :link: 

ethan_backend: Quick look at the pcap: client sends SETTINGS/HEADERS then mid-response sends RST_STREAM. Server wrote full payload to socket but client closed connection. Sequence shows client timeout -> SDK abort. So two things: adjust SDK retry policy and add a small keepalive bump at the edge to tolerate slow clients.

mike_support: Communicated workaround to customer (reduce retries, extend client timeout). They're ok with temporary change.

ethan_backend: Preparing a tiny edge patch to increase HTTP/2 keepalive from 15s -> 20s for affected pool as a stopgap. Will canary and monitor.

olson_infra: Canary deployed (20% traffic) for us-west pool. Observability: early EOF count down by 70% in canary so far. :thumbsup: 

mike_support: Customer confirmed errors dropped after they applied the SDK change and we applied canary :tada:. Leaving thread open to monitor 24h.

bot_incident: note: deploy 4950012500-edge-h2-keepalive-increase rolled to 20% at 09:58 UTC.

sara_support: Followups: create SDK issue to change default retry to 1 for streaming, add recommended client timeout guidance to troubleshooting doc, and consider a permanent keepalive flag behind runtime feature gate.

mike_support: Thanks all — I'll send a one-paragraph customer summary and open a billing hold request for suspected retry double-billing to finance.

ethan_backend: I'll keep an eye on metrics and post an update if anything weird pops up.

mike_support: Closing later today if 24h is green. :white_check_mark:
